First, determine UTC offsets:  
Europe/Paris in 1591 likely used UTC+0 (no DST, historically Paris used LMT but for simplicity treat as UTC+0).  
US/Mountain standard offset = UTC-7.  

Source time: 21:00 (Oct 15) at UTC+0 → UTC = 21:00 Oct 15.  
Target time = UTC 21:00 + (-7 hours offset) = 14:00 Oct 15.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 14:00
